verdict.rationale: Stripe documents the full agent purchase loop. The embedded ACS checkout mode manages the checkout lifecycle, from cart through payment collection, and Stripe creates and routes a scoped Shared Payment Token to the seller. Completion is signalled by `delegated_checkout.requested_session.completed` and the seller's `checkout.session.completed` event. Link CLI separately lets an agent get customer-approved one-time credentials (SPT, virtual card or Link Pay Token) to pay. The agent-builder checkout is private preview, limited to physical goods in the US, Canada and select European countries, and requires a seller-initiated OCA agreement; Link spends need per-request human approval. missing for 10: general availability of the embedded agent checkout, independent or hands-on corroboration of a completed end-to-end agent purchase, clearer end-to-end object documentation (a community comment calls the MPP docs sparse on end-to-end flow).
